releaseNotes:
Bike Sync 2.2.7

- Makes duplicate cleanup target the exact approved Bike-Sync-owned event instead of every managed workout on the date.
- Verifies the target event ID, date, title, and ownership before deleting it.
- Starts the first private coaching synchronization directly when the app initializes.
- Includes the Intervals date-and-time, launch-time synchronization, and safe replacement fixes from 2.2.6.
